subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split the remaining work into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, or also change Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, but changing Telegram's default DM session behavior would alter documented compatibility for existing users who rely on main-session continuity.

options.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
options.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while keeping Telegram DM defaults controlled by existing `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM Isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting the upgrade and documentation impact for users relying on main-session sharing.

options.title: Defer To Native Heartbeat Entries
options.body: Hold this behind the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling design, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
recommendation.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while keeping Telegram DM defaults controlled by existing `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans heartbeat routing, session compatibility, and Telegram default behavior, and the history signals point to steipete as the strongest current routing owner.
